settings.question: Are your products 100% original?
settings.answer: Yes. Everything we sell is an original from an international brand, sourced as export-surplus or outlet stock. We never sell replicas.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: 2–4 working days to Karachi, Lahore and Islamabad/Rawalpindi, and 4–7 working days elsewhere in Pakistan. Delivery is free on orders over PKR 3,000, otherwise PKR 250.

settings.question: Do you offer cash on delivery?
settings.answer: Yes, nationwide. Our team confirms your order on WhatsApp first, then you pay the courier when the parcel arrives.

settings.question: What if the size does not fit?
settings.answer: We offer a 7-day free size exchange. Message us on WhatsApp within 7 days of delivery with your order number and the size you need. Unworn items with tags only, please.

settings.question: Can I get a refund?
settings.answer: Refunds are only given when the item is not as described. For size or fit, we exchange instead.

settings.question: How do I track my order?
settings.answer: Once your parcel ships, we send the courier tracking details on WhatsApp.

settings.question: How can I contact you?
settings.answer: Message us on WhatsApp at +92 321 8780499. We reply during business hours.
